record.body:
## Question

`runner-adapter` is four tasks, all subagent, one sitting, no human stops. Wave 1 parses the manifest runner and adds `run_tests`, in parallel. Wave 2 points `aff verdict` at those outcomes, including the fixture runner and the unstable confirmation. Wave 3 runs the exit checks through `bin/aff verdict`.

Approve the plan, change the tasks, or send the phase back to discuss?
